=== TASK: TESTER WHITELIST — DELETE-AND-REPLACE + AUTO-DELETE ON FUNNEL COMPLETION ===

AWS account: 343218208384, region us-east-1.
Repo: /Users/antonio/Desktop/presttige-site/

GOAL:
Two whitelisted tester emails get clean state on every S1 submit
(delete prior record + artifacts, create fresh) AND auto-delete
the entire record once the funnel completes (Stripe checkout
success OR E5 welcome email send). Real users keep their data
unchanged.

WHITELIST (case-insensitive, normalize to lowercase):
  1. antoniompereira@me.com
  2. alternativeservice@gmail.com

NON-NEGOTIABLES:
- Whitelist as a constant or env var, easy to extend.
- Real users (any email NOT on whitelist) keep current
  duplicate-email + duplicate-phone behavior.
- Tester records are tagged `is_test = true` so any analytics
  query can filter them out.
- Funnel must complete end-to-end during the test session: E1
  verify → S2 → S3 photos → /review → E3 → /tier-select →
  Stripe → E5. Only at the FINAL step does the auto-delete fire.
- Auto-delete is silent; no error if record already gone.

=== PART A: CREATE-LEAD LAMBDA (DELETE-AND-REPLACE ON SUBMIT) ===

Source: backend/lambdas/create-lead/lambda.py
Function: presttige-create-lead

1. Add at top:
     TESTER_WHITELIST = {
         "antoniompereira@me.com",
         "alternativeservice@gmail.com",
     }
     def is_tester(email: str) -> bool:
         return (email or "").strip().lower() in TESTER_WHITELIST

2. In the lead-creation handler:
     - Normalize email to lowercase.
     - If is_tester(email):
         a) Find ALL prior lead records with that email
            (Scan with FilterExpression, or GSI lookup if
            available).
         b) For each prior record, purge:
            - EventBridge schedule (if e3_schedule_name set):
                aws scheduler delete-schedule --name <name> \
                  --group-name default
              (use boto3 scheduler client; ignore NotFound)
            - S3 photos under the lead_id prefix on the upload
              bucket (find bucket name in repo / Lambda env)
            - DynamoDB DeleteItem on the leads table
         c) Remove tester email from SES suppression list if
            present:
              aws sesv2 delete-suppressed-destination \
                --email-address <email>
            (ignore NotFound)
         d) Skip duplicate-email AND duplicate-phone checks
            for this request.
         e) Create new record with `is_test = true`.
     - Else (real user): unchanged behavior.

3. Logging:
     CloudWatch line per tester purge:
       "TESTER_PURGE_ON_SUBMIT email=<x>
        deleted_records=<n> deleted_schedules=<n>
        deleted_photos=<n> ses_suppression_removed=<bool>"

=== PART B: AUTO-DELETE ON FUNNEL COMPLETION ===

Tester records must auto-delete at the END of the funnel. Two
trigger points — implement BOTH so whichever happens first wipes
the record:

TRIGGER 1: Stripe checkout success
TRIGGER 2: E5 welcome email send

1. Identify the Stripe webhook handler Lambda (likely
   presttige-stripe-webhook or similar; search repo + Lambda
   list). On the `checkout.session.completed` event, after
   normal processing:
     - Look up the lead record being completed.
     - If record has `is_test == true` OR if the lead's email
       is in TESTER_WHITELIST:
         a) Run the same purge sequence as PART A step 2.b/c
            on this record's lead_id and email:
              - Delete EventBridge schedule
              - Delete S3 photos
              - Remove SES suppression
              - DeleteItem from leads table
         b) Log: "TESTER_PURGE_ON_FUNNEL_COMPLETE
                  trigger=stripe_success email=<x>
                  lead_id=<id>"
     - Real users: unchanged, record stays.

2. Identify the E5 send Lambda (welcome email, sender private@).
   After successful E5 SES send:
     - If is_tester(record.email) OR record.is_test == true:
         a) Same purge sequence.
         b) Log: "TESTER_PURGE_ON_FUNNEL_COMPLETE
                  trigger=e5_sent email=<x> lead_id=<id>"
     - Real users: unchanged.

3. Idempotency: if Stripe success fires first and deletes, then
   E5 fires after on a no-longer-existing record — both
   handlers must tolerate the record being already gone (catch
   ConditionalCheckFailedException / ResourceNotFoundException
   silently).

=== PART C: IAM PERMISSIONS ===

The three Lambdas (create-lead, stripe-webhook, e5-send) need:
  - dynamodb:Query, dynamodb:Scan, dynamodb:DeleteItem
  - scheduler:DeleteSchedule
  - sesv2:DeleteSuppressedDestination
  - sesv2:GetSuppressedDestination
  - s3:ListObjects (or ListObjectsV2), s3:DeleteObject on the
    upload bucket

If any role is missing these, add them via inline policy.
Scope to the leads table ARN, the upload bucket ARN, and the
default scheduler group. Log every IAM change in the report.

=== PART D: BUILD + DEPLOY ===

1. python3 -m py_compile on every modified Lambda.
2. Repackage and update each affected Lambda (same flow used
   in commit d50a95c).
3. Single commit:
     "feat(testers): whitelist with delete-and-replace on submit
      + auto-delete on funnel completion (Stripe / E5)"
4. Push. Amplify SUCCEED (frontend redeploys no-op, fine).

=== PART E: VERIFICATION ===

a) Submit S1 with antoniompereira@me.com + UAE country.
   - Expect 200, new lead_id, is_test=true, no prior record
     remaining (count=1 for this email in DB).
   - CloudWatch shows TESTER_PURGE_ON_SUBMIT log.

b) Re-submit S1 with same email + Germany country.
   - Expect 200, NEW lead_id, prior record gone, count=1.

c) Run a tester through the full funnel using Stripe test
   mode (sk_test_):
   - S1 → E1 → S2 → photos → /review approve → E3 → tier-select
     → Stripe checkout → confirm payment success.
   - After Stripe webhook fires, query DynamoDB for that
     lead_id → expect 0 records.
   - CloudWatch shows TESTER_PURGE_ON_FUNNEL_COMPLETE
     trigger=stripe_success.
   - S3 prefix for that lead_id is empty.
   - EventBridge schedule for that lead_id is gone.

d) Run a second tester through to E5 send (without Stripe path
   if possible, or simulate) → record auto-deletes with
   trigger=e5_sent.

e) Real-user regression: submit S1 with a fresh non-whitelisted
   email twice.
   - First: 200.
   - Second: returns email_exists error.
   - Confirms duplicate check still works for real users.

f) SES suppression list contains neither tester email at end
   of run.

=== REPORT AT END ===
- Files modified
- Whitelist constant location
- Commit SHA + Amplify job ID
- IAM policy additions per role (Lambda + permissions)
- Verification results for each scenario a-f
- DynamoDB record counts at each checkpoint
- CloudWatch log lines emitted (TESTER_PURGE_ON_SUBMIT,
  TESTER_PURGE_ON_FUNNEL_COMPLETE)
- Real-user regression: pass/fail
- Any placeholders / skipped / failures

=== END BRIEFING ===
